tasks.label: Check Android build tools
args: command -v flutter || true; command -v dart || true; command -v java || true; printf 'ANDROID_HOME=%s\nANDROID_SDK_ROOT=%s\n' "$ANDROID_HOME" "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"; ls -la

tasks.label: Check publish prerequisites
args: git status --short; git branch --show-current; git remote -v; gh auth status

tasks.label: Check workflow yaml syntax
args: import fs from 'node:fs'; import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; const p='.github/workflows/build-and-publish.yml'; const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); for (const token of ['workflow_dispatch:','actions/deploy-pages@v4','bash scripts/build_apk.sh','npm test --prefix server']) assert(s.includes(token), `missing workflow step: ${token}`); console.log('Workflow required steps present.');

tasks.label: Commit APK site workflow
tasks.command: bash -lc 'git add .github/workflows/build-and-publish.yml .gitignore README.md lib pubspec.yaml scripts server site && git diff --cached --stat && git commit -m "Build and publish exam prep APK site" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>"'

tasks.label: Commit Flutter compile fix
tasks.command: bash -lc 'git add lib/screens/home_screen.dart && git commit -m "Fix tutor card Flutter compilation" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>"'

tasks.label: Check build job progress
tasks.command: gh run view 40842260414 --repo asysu/apk --json jobs --jq '.jobs[] | {name: .name, status: .status, conclusion: .conclusion, steps: [.steps[] | {name: .name, status: .status, conclusion: .conclusion}]}'

tasks.label: Commit Pages activation fix
tasks.command: bash -lc 'git add .github/workflows/build-and-publish.yml && git commit -m "Enable Pages deployment and retain APK artifact" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>" && git push origin main'

tasks.label: Check final workflow progress
tasks.command: gh run view 40842884706 --repo asysu/apk --json status,conclusion,jobs,url --jq '{status, conclusion, url, jobs: [.jobs[] | {name, status, conclusion, steps: [.steps[] | {name, status, conclusion}]}]}'

tasks.label: Verify published APK
tasks.command: gh run view 40842884706 --repo asysu/apk --json status,conclusion,jobs,url --jq '{status, conclusion, url, jobs: [.jobs[] | {name, status, conclusion, steps: [.steps[] | {name, status, conclusion}]}]}'

tasks.label: Check build artifact availability
tasks.command: gh run view 40842884706 --repo asysu/apk --json status,conclusion,jobs,url --jq '{status, conclusion, url, jobs: [.jobs[] | {status, conclusion, steps: [.steps[] | {name, status, conclusion}]}]}'

tasks.label: Wait for APK build stage
tasks.command: bash -lc 'sleep 60; gh run view 40842884706 --repo asysu/apk --json status,conclusion,jobs,url --jq "{status, conclusion, url, steps: [.jobs[0].steps[] | {name, status, conclusion}]}"'

tasks.label: Download built APK artifact
tasks.command: gh run download 40842884706 --repo asysu/apk --name imtahan-hazirligi-apk --dir site/downloads
